name: primary suspension
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_en: The suspension connecting the wheelsets and bogie frames in the source vehicle model.
usage_note: 虚拟自由度用于表达其与高自由度轮对的耦合。

complete_examples.text: The spring and dashpot for the primary suspension are character-ized by spring stiffness kp and damping coefficient cp, respectively.

Based on the methods developed in the present study, numerical examples have been conducted to draw the following marks: track irregularities possess the dominant role in guiding the dynamic performance of vehicle–track systems, besides, the vertical stiffness of primary suspension and rail pads also shows significant influence on vertical acceleration of the car body and the wheel–rail vertical force, respectively.
However, the contribution of system parameters is relatively small compared to track profile geometries except the lateral stiffness of primary suspension.
Among the suspensions, the primary suspension is equipped between the wheelsets and the bogie frames, and the secondary suspension connects the car body with the bogie frames.
The primary suspension between the bogie and wheel-set, and the secondary suspension between the car body and bogie are modeled as linear spring-damper elements.

X, _X, and €X denote the displacement, velocity, and acceleration of the vehicle-track system, respectively; F is the loading vector; the subscripts “V,” “W,” and “T” represent the vehicle, wheelset, and track, respectively; the subscripts “VW” and “WV” denote the primary suspension interaction matrices; the subscripts “WT” and “TW” denote the wheel-rail interaction matrices.
